# secureaccess_resource_connector_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Resource Connector Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_resource_connector_group" "example" {
  name        = "my resource connector group"
  region      = "us-west-2"
  environment = "container"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment in which agents will be deployed.
  - Choices: `aws`, `azure`, `container`, `esx`
- `name` (String) Name of the Resource Connector Group.
- `region` (String) The region where to deploy Resource Connector Group on Cisco Secure Access.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_resource_connector_group.example "<id>"
```
